scripts.install:all: bash -lc 'for app in apps/*; do [ -f "$app/package.json" ] || continue; echo "==> install ${app}"; npm --prefix "$app" install || exit 1; done'
scripts.build:all: bash -lc 'for app in apps/*; do [ -f "$app/package.json" ] || continue; echo "==> build ${app}"; npm --prefix "$app" run build --if-present || exit 1; done'
